dogecoin.text:
Now, Bitcoin is currently at $90,444.01, and Dogecoin is at $0.3985. 

These are the coins people are bullish and excited about because they’ve seen significant pumps due to trends and news.

0.2 $DOGE!

My Dogecoin was gone!

At first, I was confused and a bit suspicious. But then it clicked... I might have done this to myself!

I missed the Bullrun!

These were the thoughts that kept repeating in my head.
